acceptance: A parameterised SELECT returns query-plan rows including a detail field.
Existing JSON/newline/CSV/table output options remain usable for plan rows.
EXPLAIN of INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE or DDL does not change schema or data.
Without --explain, pre-existing query behaviour is unchanged.
prohibited_shortcuts: Do not special-case the acceptance SQL strings.
Do not execute the original statement before or after explaining it.
feature.requirement: Add --explain to the sqlite-utils query command. When enabled, the command must execute EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN for the supplied SQL and parameters using the existing output-format options. The original statement must not execute and must not change persistent database state.
feature.title: Query-plan inspection
